data.body: Patch set 1 of Gerrit 3309 (handler following the CURRENT sys.stderr) got Verified -1 at 10:27 PST: tests/unit/test_compact_fold_prelock.py::test_the_detached_sweep_worker_writes_the_timing_line_to_its_log failed on py3.11/3.12/3.13 with empty worker stderr. Cause, confirmed locally (fails on that commit, passes with origin/main _logging.py): compact.py:389 wraps the fold in contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()), and the timing line logs inside it, so a handler that follows sys.stderr writes into the discarded buffer. Revised approach (description updated): the handler writes to sys.__stderr__, the process stream, which neither pytest capture nor redirect_stderr swaps. New regression tests: 3 fail on origin/main's _logging.py and 3 fail on the first-attempt handler; all 3 pass on the revision. test_compact_fold_prelock.py passes 10/10; the facade pair passes in both orders; both facade modules pass 29/29 in both orders.
